description: Dortmund's opening MAT-0005 stock is zeroed out (usable_quantity -> 0) while opening_total_value_eur stays positive, an inconsistent zero-quantity/positive-value pool. Chosen over the NODE-0006 opening row because Dortmund's only outflows (service, closing) are elastic and adapt to whatever is actually available, so the mutation surfaces as a reconciliation-identity failure rather than cascading into an unrelated pinned-dispatch infeasibility.
